question: According to Environment Performance Index (EPI) 2024, what was India's rank in greenhouse gas production in May 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3rd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India ranked **3rd** in greenhouse gas production according to the Environment Performance Index (EPI) 2024.
 
• The EPI is a biennial report by Yale and Columbia Universities in collaboration with the World Economic Forum.
 
• The ranking is based on 32 performance indicators across 11 issue categories.
 
• Greenhouse gas emissions are a significant factor in assessing a country's environmental health and climate change mitigation.
 
• China and the United States hold the top two positions respectively in greenhouse gas production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Environment Performance Index (EPI)**

 
 
• The EPI is a method to quantify and numerically mark the environmental performance of a country's policies.
 
• The index is a joint initiative between Yale University and Columbia University.
 
• It incorporates data from international organizations such as the World Bank and the World Health Organization.
 
• The EPI covers 180 countries and ranks them based on environmental health and ecosystem vitality.
 
 
 
• **Greenhouse Gases (GHGs)**
 
 
• GHGs are gases that trap heat in the atmosphere, leading to the greenhouse effect and global warming.
 
• Key GHGs include carbon dioxide (CO₂), methane (CH₄), nitrous oxide (N₂O), and fluorinated gases.
 
• Human activities such as burning fossil fuels, deforestation, and industrial processes increase GHG concentrations.
 
• Mitigating GHG emissions is crucial for combating climate change.
 
 
 
• **Climate Change Mitigation**
 
 
• Climate change mitigation involves efforts to reduce or prevent the emission of GHGs.
 
• Strategies include transitioning to renewable energy sources, enhancing energy efficiency, and adopting sustainable practices.
 
• International agreements such as the Paris Agreement aim to unite countries in reducing global GHG emissions.
 
• Effective climate policies can help stabilize global temperatures and prevent adverse environmental impacts.
